supersedes.reason: Hostile review found that v1 froze data production and stratum derivation but did not pre-register the primary comparison. V2 changes no call, horizon, treatment, exposure, count, threshold, genome, World, or generated evidence; it closes interpretation discretion before any final-cohort life exists.

analysisRules.primaryContrastRationale: Within each primary comparison, Pass-B call ordinal fixes visible-history depth across all five Threads while the independently frozen cohort genome differs by Thread. Analyse ordinal 3 and ordinal 6 separately; do not pool them as though horizon were exchangeable.
analysisRules.betweenStratumConfoundNote: The three strata occupy disjoint history horizons: clean life_only_unexposed is guaranteed at horizons 4-5, life_plus_genome occurs at horizons 6 and 10, and conditional life_only_exposed occurs at horizons 7-8. No genome-blind call exists at horizon 6 or 10, so between-stratum differences cannot identify a genome effect separately from history depth.
analysisRules.g2CeilingConstraint: Genome-specific inference is allowed only for the five G2-measured pairs; the slot-3/slot-4 pair has an inconclusive direct-visibility ceiling.
